scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Please provide us your email, so we can sent you a login code. Then click the Send Code button.

scenes.label: enter-the-code
scenes.line: We sent you a four-digit code to that address. {.3} If you are not seeing it, check your spam folder.

scenes.label: dashboard
scenes.line: This is your dashboard. {.5} You can return here anytime with the command + K short keys.

scenes.label: find-the-business
scenes.line: Type the name of a business, then select it from the dropdown list.

scenes.label: the-business
scenes.line: This is the business info page. {.3} Click the lookup icon to find the stores.

scenes.label: find-the-store
scenes.line: Type the store name, {.3} then select it from the dropdown list.

scenes.label: the-store
scenes.line: Now you are on the store details page. {.3} Click the gear, then choose Lookup Items.

scenes.label: item-list
scenes.line: This is the lookup items search. {.3} To add new item, {.3} click the plus button.

scenes.label: new-item
scenes.line: Give the item a name. Then choose the collection it belongs to, and create this item.

scenes.label: item-details
scenes.line: Now add the item details. Add an image first. {1} Then add a description, {10} Add the quantity. {3} And the price. {3} Select the requirement. {3} Then select the boot size as a variant {2} and save.

scenes.label: saved
scenes.line: That is the item ready for the store to rent.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: Back to the dashboard where you can log out or select a card option.
